mapper.select: SELECT s.parking_spot_id AS spotId, s.parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, s.parking_floor AS parkingFloor, s.parking_row AS parkingRow, s.parking_column AS parkingColumn, s.is_parked AS isParked FROM parking_spot s JOIN ev_charger e ON s.parking_spot_id = e.parking_spot_id WHERE s.is_parked = false ORDER BY s.parking_floor ASC, (ABS(s.parking_row - 1) + ABS(s.parking_column - 1)) ASC, s.parking_row ASC, s.parking_column ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.parking_spot_id AS spotId, s.parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, s.parking_floor AS parkingFloor, s.parking_row AS parkingRow, s.parking_column AS parkingColumn, s.is_parked AS isParked FROM parking_spot s LEFT JOIN ev_charger e ON s.parking_spot_id = e.parking_spot_id WHERE s.is_parked = false AND e.ev_charger_id IS NULL ORDER BY s.parking_floor ASC, (ABS(s.parking_row - 1) + ABS(s.parking_column - 1)) ASC, s.parking_row ASC, s.parking_column ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_spot SET is_parked = false, parking_log_id = NULL WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.parking_spot_id AS spotId, s.parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, s.parking_floor AS parkingFloor, s.parking_row AS parkingRow, s.parking_column AS parkingColumn, s.is_parked AS isParked, l.vehicle_num AS vehicleNum, l.entry_time AS entryTime FROM parking_spot s LEFT JOIN parking_log l ON s.parking_log_id = l.parking_log_id ORDER BY s.parking_floor ASC, s.parking_row ASC, s.parking_column ASC
